status: The nested-optionals, typed-outcome and defaults-and-methods examples execute unchanged in the existing I04 source runner. Interface, generic and callable examples remain later-milestone specification fixtures; not all cases are executed.

cases.contract: An outer present value with an absent payload is distinct from outer absence.
capture stores typed failure; consuming matching does not erase the error type.
Omitted argument defaults and an implicit read receiver compose without owning copies of self.
Public success types, method results and contextual closures infer while callable annotations, typed failure and stored-outcome parentheses remain explicit.
An interface declaration without a body must explicitly specify a result, including Unit.
Inferring a result does not introduce an undeclared throws effect.
A bare none leaves its payload unknown; a caller's expected optional type cannot determine the declaration result.
Multiple eligible input sources require an explicit borrowed result/source contract, even when the body returns a view of only one.
